name: Ukusetshenziswa kwezidakamizwa nokulutheka
tagline: Utshwala, izidakamizwa - kanjani ukukubona, kuphi usizo.
sources: SANCA (South African National Council on Alcoholism and Drug Dependence)

urgent.heading: Okuphuthumayo - shayela manje uma
urgent.primary_message: Ukweqisa, ukuhoxa kakhulu, noma imicabango yokuzilimaza kudinga usizo olusheshayo. Ungalindi. Ungabi wedwa.
red_flags: Uqulekile, kunzima ukuvuka, noma akusabeli ngemva kokusebenzisa
Ukuphefumula kancane kakhulu, ngokungajwayelekile, noma cha (ikakhulukazi ngama-opioid afana ne-heroin noma i-whoonga)
Ukuhlanza okunamandla okungapheli, ikakhulukazi uma ukozela
Ukuquleka ngesikhathi sokuhoxa - ikakhulukazi otshwaleni noma benzodiazepines
Ukudideka okukhulu, ukuyaluza, ukubona izinto ezingekho, noma umkhuhlane
Imicabango yokuzilimaza, ukuzibulala, noma ukulimaza omunye umuntu

what_is_it.heading: Ukusetshenziswa kwezidakamizwa ngamagama alula
what_is_it.lede: Ukusetshenziswa kwezidakamizwa kuba yinkinga uma kuqala ukulimaza impilo yakho, ubudlelwano bakho, umsebenzi wakho, noma umuzwa wakho ngawe - futhi lapho uthola ukuthi awukwazi ukuyeka, noma ngabe ufuna.
paragraphs: Ukulutheka kuyisimo sezempilo, hhayi ukwehluleka ukuziphatha. Into ishintsha indlela umvuzo wobuchopho nezinhlelo zokucindezeleka ezisebenza ngayo, okwenza ukusetshenziswa okuqhubekayo kuzizwe kudingekile ukuze nje uzizwe ujwayelekile. Yingakho amandla engqondo ewodwa ngokuvamile enganele - nokuthi kungani kubalulekile ukwelashwa.

ENingizimu Afrika, utshwala budala umonakalo omkhulu kakhulu, kulandelwa i-methamphetamine (i-tik, ikakhulukazi eNtshonalanga Kapa), insangu, i-heroin kanye ne-'whoonga'/nyaope (izidakamizwa zasemgwaqweni ezisekelwe ku-heroin), kanye nemithi kadokotela. Indlela yokuphuma ihlukile kuzo zonke, kodwa zonke ziqala ngesinyathelo esifanayo - ukufinyelela.

items.headline: Isimo sezempilo
items.body: Ukulutheka yisimo sezempilo esiqashelwayo esihlanganisa izinguquko zobuchopho. Ukwelashwa kuyasebenza - ukululama kuyiqiniso.

items.headline: Okuvamile
items.body: Cishe umuntu oyedwa kwabahlanu waseNingizimu Afrika uzozabalaza nenkinga yokusebenzisa izidakamizwa ngesikhathi esithile. Awuwedwa.

items.headline: I-SANCA imahhala
items.body: I-SANCA inezikhungo zokuhlola nokwelashwa zamahhala eNingizimu Afrika yonkana. I-Detox, ukwelulekwa, kanye ne-rehab - alukho usizo lwezokwelapha oludingekayo.

items.headline: Ukuhoxiswa kuyiqiniso
items.body: Ukuhoxiswa kotshwala kanye ne-benzodiazepine kungaba yingozi empilweni - ungalokothi uyeke ukubanda okubandayo wedwa. I-detox yezokwelapha iphephile futhi imahhala emitholampilo eminingi.

pull_quote.text: Ukubuyisela akukona mayelana namandla. Kumayelana nokuthola usizo olufanele ngesikhathi esifanele. Umuntu ocela usizo kube kanye akuyena lo muntu obeluthwele yedwa — basuke benesibindi.

signs.heading: Izimpawu ezisetshenziswayo seziyinkinga
signs.lede: Ukusetshenziswa kwezidakamizwa ku-spectrum - kusukela ekusetshenzisweni, ekusetshenzisweni kabi, kuye ekuncikeni. Awudingi ukuba phansi ukuze ucele usizo. Ngaphambili kulula.

items.title: Idinga okwengeziwe
items.description: Ukusebenzisa okungaphezu kwalokho obukujwayele ukwenza umphumela ofanayo. Ukuphuza ekuseni kakhulu. Ukusebenzisa lapho uwedwa, noma into yokuqala ekuseni. Ukufihla inani kwabanye.

items.title: Ayikwazi ukuma
items.description: Ezama ukusika ehluleka. Izethembiso kuwena noma kwabanye ongeke ukwazi ukuzigcina. Ukusebenzisa noma wazi ukuthi kulimaza impilo yakho, umndeni, noma umsebenzi wakho.

items.title: Izimpawu zokuhoxa
items.description: Ukuzizwa ugula (ukuqhaqhazela, ukujuluka, isicanucanu, ukukhathazeka) lapho ungakasebenzisi emahoreni ambalwa. Ukusebenzisa nje ukuzizwa ujwayelekile, hhayi ukuzizwa uphakeme. Uphawu olucacile umzimba usulungisile.

items.fact: Amashumi eminyaka ocwaningo lobuchopho akhombisa ukuba umlutha kuhilela izinguquko zangempela emijikelezweni yobuchopho - umvuzo, ingcindezi, ukwenza izinqumo. Kuyisimo sezempilo esisabela ekwelashweni, hhayi ukushiyeka komlingiswa.

items.myth: Kufanele ushayeke phansi ngaphambi kokuthi ukwelashwa kusebenze.
items.fact: Ngaphambili kulula. Abantu abathola usizo besasebenza, besemndenini, basasebenza banamazinga aphezulu kakhulu okutakula kunalabo abalinda kuze kulahleke yonke into.

items.myth: Kufanele ngikwazi ukuyeka ngedwa. Ukucela usizo kusho ukuthi ngehlulekile.
items.fact: Abantu abaningi abalulama ekuluthweni bathola usizo lochwepheshe. Ukuzama kukodwa kunezinga eliphansi kakhulu lempumelelo. Ukucela usizo kuyinto eyodwa ephumelela kakhulu ongayenza.

Ukubuyisela kungokoqobo futhi kuhlala isikhathi eside kubantu abaningi. Ubuchopho bushintsha ekusetshenzisweni kwezidakamizwa bungaphola ngokuhamba kwesikhathi nokwelashwa. Izigidi eziningi zabantu ziye zakha kabusha ukuphila kwazo.

items.title: Shayela i-SANCA — ukuhlolwa kwamahhala nokudluliselwa
items.description: 0861 472 622 izokuxhumanisa negatsha le-SANCA eliseduze nawe. Balalela, bahlole, babhekisele ekwelashweni kwamahhala. Akukho ukwahlulela.

items.title: Ungazami ukukhipha utshwala uwedwa
items.description: Ukuhoxa kakhulu utshwala kungabangela ukuquleka ngisho nokufa. Uma uphuza kakhulu nsuku zonke, khuluma nomtholampilo ngaphambi kokuyeka. I-detox yezokwelapha imahhala futhi iphephe kakhulu.

items.title: Uma usebenzisa ama-opioid - yazi nge-overdose
items.description: I-Heroin, i-whoonga, namaphilisi ezinhlungu kadokotela angayeka ukuphefumula. Ungalokothi usebenzise uwedwa uma ungakwazi ukukugwema. I-Naloxone ihlehlisa ukweqisa umthamo — buza i-SANCA ukuthi iyithathaphi.

items.title: Tshela umuntu oyedwa omethembayo
items.description: Ilungu lomndeni, umngane, umholi wezenkolo, udokotela — noma ngabe ubani omethemba kakhulu. Ukusho phezulu kanye kwephula imfihlo egcina iqhubeka.

items.title: Uma umuntu omthandayo usebenzisa
items.description: Khuluma ngokukhathazeka, hhayi ukusongela. 'Ngiyakuthanda futhi ngikhathazekile' kunamandla kunokuthi 'udinga ukuyeka'. I-SANCA iphinde isize imindeni - hhayi abasebenzisi kuphela.

get_help.heading: Lapho okumele uye khona
get_help.lede: Ukwelashwa kokusetshenziswa kwezidakamizwa eNingizimu Afrika kufinyeleleka kakhulu kunalokho abantu abaningi abakucabangayo. Amagatsha e-SANCA akhona kuzo zonke izikhungo ezinkulu. Imitholampilo kahulumeni ihlinzeka nge-detox yezokwelapha. Usizo luseduze kunalokho ucabanga.
